messages:
mika: PR #4127 ready for docs review — migration guide for v0.9 SDK + updated SDK snippet. Aiming to merge during docs merge window today at 16:00 PT. Can reviewers please take a look?
alex: I can review. quick q — did you update the term 'tenant' -> 'workspace' per the style guide?
jess: Thanks for the ping. If it mentions 'customers' when you mean SDK users, swap to 'developers' or 'engineers' (voice checklist).
olivia: I will review examples. tiny preference: use `Client.from_env()` instead of an inline API key in snippets.
mika: Good call — switched to `Client.from_env()` in the Python and JS examples. Also added a short before/after migration table and a note about model routing policy.
ci-bot: Build failed: docs preview error — BrokenAnchorError: 'workspace-setup' not found in migration.md. See logs for anchor resolution.
mika: Ack, fixing the anchor in migration.md now — must have renamed the header earlier.
mika: Fixed the anchor and pushed. Re-running previews.
docs-preview-bot: Docs preview ready: https://preview.redwood.ai/docs/PR-4127 — please sanity-check formatting, code blocks, and tone.
jess: Quick tone pass: soften a couple of imperial sentences in the migration checklist (e.g., change "Do X" -> "You can X"). Also prefer 'straightforward' over 'simple' in guidance copy per style guide.
olivia: Code examples look good. One small API detail: our streaming example should use generator style. Change this:
```python
for chunk in client.stream_completions(prompt):
    print(chunk.text)
```
instead of using `with client.stream()`
mika: Updated the snippet to the generator loop and added an inline comment about backpressure. Also added a one-line rollback step as requested in the runbook.
alex: I added an approval on the PR. @olivia @jess can you do a final pass? If green, I'll merge at 16:10 PT (10-minute buffer after the docs window).
jess: Done a final micro-pass. Left one punctuation nit in the bullet list (not blocking).
olivia: Approving now. Left a suggestion for clearer phrasing in the rollback step (not blocking).
mika: Thanks everyone — unless there are objections I'll merge at 16:10 PT.
docs-preview-bot: Deploy preview updated: https://preview.redwood.ai/docs/PR-4127 — all visual checks passed.
ci-bot: CI: docs build succeeded — 0 warnings.
alex: :tada: merged PR #4127. Thanks for the quick reviews and the tone cleanup — looks much better for customers and internal teams.
